rules.rule: Repository hygiene: the tracked YouVersionPlatformConfiguration.configure() call must keep the exact appKey argument appKey: <#Your App Key#>. Flag any replacement of this placeholder or addition of an app key anywhere in this file, including comments, constants, and commented-out code, and recommend restoring the placeholder before merge. This applies to test, staging, demo, and personal keys. Actual app keys must remain unstaged local changes and must never be committed. App keys are public configuration, not secrets; explain findings as repository tidiness and avoiding confusion, not a security incident. Do not repeat the key value in review comments or suggested fixes; identify the location and recommend restoring the placeholder.

No hardcoded user-facing UI strings: use String.localized("dotted.key") for Text, Button, Label, navigationTitle, alert, confirmationDialog, accessibilityLabel, and accessibilityHint. CI scripts/check-no-hardcoded-ui-strings.sh and SwiftLint hardcoded_ui_string enforce this. See docs/localization-guardrails.md.

Localizable.xcstrings is upstream-owned by platform-localization. Do not edit in feature PRs. Add English keys as swift.* (or shared unprefixed keys) in platform-localization sources/common/en.json; translations arrive via Crowdin and sync PRs on branch chore/localization-sync-swift (legacy chore/localization-sync-swift-* branches also accepted) authored by app/platform-localization-pr-bot. See docs/localization-guardrails.md.
